'''Southwest One''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the continent of [[Anai]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. Along with [[Southwest Two]], the cities were established to support the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] industries and exploit the planet's mineral wealth.
